title: Be Yourself: Bounded Attention for Multi-Subject Text-to-Image Generation
role: The default fix for the one-fix step: masks cross- and self-attention per subject box, training-free, needs user boxes
enters: a combination: cross-attention and self-attention, reinforced by conjunction/number tokens and the first [EoT] padding token
enters_evidence: measurement shown as PCA scatter plots of cross-attention queries (mixed for kitten+puppy, hamster+squirrel) and self-attention maps (crab eye attends to frog eye); no statistic
changes: adds a 0/-inf mask to the attention logits so each subject's pixels and tokens see only themselves and the background; early latent guidance with a masked box-localisation loss; box masks replaced by self-attention KMeans segments after guidance
training: nothing trained; needs one bounding box per subject from the user (no automatic layout), subject token spans, and a POS tagger to drop conjunctions and numbers
model: SD (version not printed) for all numbers; SDXL qualitative only; 50 steps; layers 12-19 (SD) and 70-81 (SDXL)
similar_subjects: user study on 5 ChatGPT-chosen visually similar animal pairs x 4 layouts, 32 users, 330 responses: probability a picked image is BA's 0.85 vs Layout-guidance, 0.72 vs BoxDiff, 0.95 vs MultiDiffusion (0-1, 0.5 = parity); model not named
which_pairs: argument plus PCA plots: semantic similarity gives close cross-attention queries at all decoder layers; texture similarity gives overlap only at the 64x64 layer; no number linking similarity to leakage
when: not measured; cites prior work that subject outlines are set in the initial steps and fine-detail leaks emerge late; guidance limited to t in [T, 0.7T]
cost: run time per image not printed; 5 gradient-descent iterations (UNet forward+backward) per guidance step over the first 30% of 50 steps, about 75 extra passes (inferred); KMeans on GPU every 5 steps
headline: DrawBench counting recall 0.88 vs 0.78 for SD, Layout-guidance and BoxDiff (0-1, higher better), counting F1 0.82 vs 0.76 BoxDiff, spatial accuracy 0.36 vs 0.35 Layout-guidance, on SD
suggests: (inferred) Cross-attention overlap is the predictor it supports, split by layer resolution; for CO3, take boxes or masks from CO3's own early self-attention clusters and run Bounded Denoising only, masking all of CO3's noise-prediction passes consistently
